outcome: Accuracy of placenta accreta index (PAI) in predicting morbidly adherent placenta
cohort: 45 pregnant women between 28 and 37 weeks of gestation with at least one previous cesarean section and ultrasound-proven placenta previa
finding: The placenta accreta index (PAI) demonstrated high sensitivity, specificity, and predictive values for morbidly adherent placenta, with excellent interrater reliability between two radiologists.
